question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word / words.

options.text: But after ten minutes it came into sight again, drawn up at the side of the road.
He seemed to weave, like the spider, from pure impulse, without reflection.
In the instant they passed it they herd a blur of voices from behind the reticence of the limousine.
When Doctor Kimble gave physic, it was natural that it should have an effect.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"herd"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling should be **"heard"**.

 
 
• **Incorrect word:** **"herd" (a group of animals of a single kind, especially cattle, sheep, or goats that are kept together) (झुंड)**

 
 
• **Example:** The shepherd guided the herd to the nearby meadow.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Correct word: "heard" **(past tense of hear; to perceive with the ear the sound made by someone or something) (सुना)
 
 
• **Example:** I heard a strange noise coming from the basement last night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "But after ten minutes it came into sight again, drawn up at the side of the road." (सही वाक्य)

 
 
• **Example:** The car came into sight again after ten minutes.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He seemed to weave, like the spider, from pure impulse, without reflection." (सही वाक्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He weaved his thoughts like a spider weaves its web.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "When Doctor Kimble gave physic, it was natural that it should have an effect." (सही वाक्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The physic given by Doctor Kimble had a quick effect.
